what_changed: NCUA final rule (effective July 16, 2026) replacing 12 CFR part 749 with a vital records preservation program: 749.1 defines vital records (e.g., current share, deposit and loan balances by member; month-end financial report); 749.2 requires a written program with a storage and destruction schedule and a records preservation log in any format; 749.3 requires oversight of any third-party provider maintaining vital records; 749.4-749.5 allow any accurate, reproducible format. Appendices A and B are repealed, and 12 CFR 703.105(d) is removed. 749.0(b) states other records preservation requirements are not superseded.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Does the servicing deployment hold any credit union client's vital records (e.g., current loan balance lists), bringing it under the 749.3 oversight requirement?
Do any credit union clients' retention schedules for call recordings or payment records still cite the repealed Appendix A?
rationale: Full text read in full (4,172 words). The rule governs disaster-recovery preservation of vital records and repeals nonbinding retention guidelines; 749.0(b) leaves other retention law in place, so no retention duty for borrower contacts, disclosures or payments changes under the v1.2 record-retention test. Not auto-closed because 749.3 adds a vendor-oversight duty that could reach a provider holding vital records. Stage B: full text read.
